name: @w6w-apps/kustomer
description: Manage Kustomer customers, conversations, messages, notes, custom objects and CSAT surveys.

w6w.longDescription:
Kustomer is a customer-service CRM built around the customer's own timeline rather than a queue of tickets. This app covers that timeline end to end: creating and looking up customers, opening and updating conversations, recording messages on a conversation, adding internal notes, and tagging conversations for routing or reporting.

Beyond the conversation surface, it reaches Kustomer's custom-object layer (Klasses and their KObject instances) for organizations that model domain data — orders, subscriptions, shipments — directly inside Kustomer, plus the access-management objects a workflow needs to route or attribute work: teams and users. CSAT survey configuration and individual satisfaction responses round out visibility into support quality.

Composing and sending outbound customer messages through a channel (email, chat, SMS, ...) is deliberately out of scope: Kustomer models that through a separate, per-channel Draft resource with a materially different request shape per channel, which this app's first version does not attempt.
